programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Toto
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks. The band formed in LA in the late 70's by a group of friends who were all much in demand session musicians. They went on to epitomize the classic American pop/rock sound of the 80's and 90's with hit albums and singles including Hold The Line, Africa, I'll Be Over You and the multi-Grammy winning worldwide hit Rosanna.

programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Celebrated and adored by millions, she was the Queen of people's hearts, yet the bittersweet story of the last man to truly capture hers has never before. In a story that until now has remained untold, Diana introduces a time in the Princess's life that was important in shaping her final years...

programme.title: One Night In Miami…
programme.desc: This powerful film is a fictional account of one incredible night where American icons Muhammad Ali (Eli Goree), Malcolm X (Kingsley Ben-Adir), Sam Cooke (Leslie Odom Jr.), and Jim Brown (Aldis Hodge) gathered, discussing their roles in the civil rights movement and cultural upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: Murder at the Mansion
programme.desc: Deanna and her fiancé Karl travel to his family's estate where they plan to be married. But someone in Karl's family is determined to stop the marriage in the simplest way possible: by killing the bride! A.K.A. Engaged to a Pyscho

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Jen Richards, a successful plastic surgeon, becomes entangled in the web of a narcissist patient whose path to perfection threatens to destroy Jen and her family.

programme.title: Keep the Aspidistra Flying
programme.desc: Gordon Comstock quits his job at an advertising agency in order to write poetry, only to find that poets, like everyone else, need money.

programme.title: Dark Encounter
programme.desc: This eerie supernatural thriller will get under your skin. After the mysterious disappearance of their daughter, grieving Olivia (Laura Fraser: Breaking Bad) and Ray (Mel Raido: Legend) notice strange lights near their home. This weird phenomena will eventually lead them to a dark and disturbing truth. Also starring Alice Lowe (Sightseers) and Grant Masters (Await Further Instructions).

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury "consultant" will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

programme.title: Snitch (2013)
programme.desc: A father (Dwayne Johnson) goes undercover for the DEA in order to free his son who was imprisoned after being set up in a drug deal.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Superhumans defy a government plot to harness and abuse their powers. Chris Evans and Dakota Fanning (the TWILIGHT films) team in a pulse-pounding paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Righteous Kill
programme.desc: Two veteran New York City detectives (Academy-Award-winners Robert De Niro and Al Pacino) hunt a vigilante who may be one of their own.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis: Men of Courage
programme.desc: The harrowing tale of American heroes shipwrecked in shark-infested waters in the waning days of WWII.

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of army medic and conscientious objector Desmond Doss who, during WWII, saved 75 men without firing or carrying a gun.

programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: Set in a dugout in Aisne in 1918, it is the story of a group of British officers as they await their fate.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Four Jewish brothers living in Nazi occupied Poland join up with Russian resistance fighters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: To Be Someone
programme.desc: When an unhinged gangster coerces young nightclub owner, Danny, into completing an illegal drugs run to The Isle of Wight in return for his shares in the club, Danny's friends step in with an ingenious plan - they will all go to The Isle of Wight's annual Mod festival and use the thousands of Mod enthusiasts descending onto the island as a cover! A feel-good tale of modern-day mods, music, and scooter culture from the producer of The Krays and Love, Honor and Obey, starring the original cast of cult mods n' rockers film, Quadrophenia, including Leslie Ash (Men Behaving Badly), Mark Wingett (Snow White and the Huntsman), Toyah Willcox (Invasion Planet Earth), Trevor Laird (Doctor Who) and Gary Shail, alongside Sam Gittins (Await Further Instructions) and Perry Benson (This is England, Sid and Nancy).

programme.title: A Family Man
programme.desc: From the Writer of The Accountant and Ozark comes an unforgettably moving drama with an all-star cast featuring Gerard Butler, Gretchen Mol, and Willem Dafoe. A head-hunter, desperate to climb to the top of the corporate ladder, grows distant from his family as his life increasingly revolves around closing deals in a survival-of-the-fittest boiler room. But these dreams suddenly grind to a halt when his son is diagnosed with a life-threatening illness.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: My Zoe
programme.desc: An emotionally-engaging, heartbreaking family drama with a dystopian sci-fi twist, starring Julie Delpy (Before Sunrise), Richard Armitage (The Stranger), Gemma Arterton (Summerland) and Daniel Brhl (Captain America: Civil War). Top-level scientist Isabelle is forced to stay in contact with her ex as they are co-parent their daughter and when tragedy strikes she takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Bryan Cranston (Breaking Bad) delivers a tour-de-force performance as a successful lawyer and family man Howard Wakefield, whose nervous breakdown causes him to disappear from his own life. Featuring supporting stars, Jennifer Garner (Dallas Buyer's Club), Beverley D'Angelo (Entourage) and Jason O'Mara (The Good Wife), this is a hilarious look into the ultimate midlife crisis!

programme.title: Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain is a shocking and heart-breaking true-story, executive produced by Morgan Freeman and starring Frankie Faison (The Wire). The film is a true story of the final hours of the life of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African-American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were sent to his home to check on him.

programme.title: Rise of the Viking
programme.desc: From the director of epic fantasy, Black Sails and starring Breaking Bad's Jonathan Banks comes this historical actioner perfect for all Game of Thrones fans. 754 AD- during a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of the pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity. Redbad must unite a Viking army to defeat the seemingly invincible Franks.

They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: Avalanche (1999)
programme.desc: The survivor of an Alaskan avalanche, Dr. Lia Freeman (Caroleen Feeney) is an environmentalist concerned about a similar disaster occurring if a proposed new oil pipeline is built. Freeman adamantly warns the planners of the likelihood of a major avalanche, but they ignore her pleas. As she realizes that a massive whiteout is imminent, Freeman tries to get the citizens of a nearby town to leave, aided by brave helicopter pilot Neal Meekin (Thomas Ian Griffith).

programme.title: Muddy Waters, Horace Silver & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed three talented Americans: pianist Horace Silver, guitarist Muddy Waters, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, alongside their bands.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively. Revel in Frank Sinatra's iconic version of “I've Got You Under My Skin". Immerse yourself in Dizzy Gillespie's dynamic performance of “Let Me Outta Here”, recorded live in Denmark in 1970. Enjoy Tony Bennett's unforgettable performance of “It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing)” at London's majestic Royal Albert Hall in 1974. Let the haunting beauty of Nat King Cole's 1957 performance of “Autumn Leaves” and Louis Armstrong's performance of “Basin Street Blues” from 1959 delight you. Dean Martin's smooth vocal stylings will enthrall you as he performs the jazz standard “Wrap Your Troubles In Dreams". Witness the electrifying energy of Sammy Davis Jr.'s performance of “Too Close For Comfort”. Join us for this unforgettable musical experience that you'll surely cherish!

programme.title: Paul Desmond, Dave Brubeck & Joe Morello
programme.sub-title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history. Captured at the pinnacle of their power and popularity, Paul Desmond (alto sax), Joe Morello (drums), Eugene Wright (bass) and Dave Brubeck (piano) explore the trails they blazed into the realm of odd time signatures with ‘Forty Days' and two versions of their groundbreaking hit ‘Take Five', as well as forays into world music with a unique exploration of ‘Koto Song'. Their intimate onstage chemistry and impeccable musicianship made the DBQ an award-winning jazz supergroup.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gary Burton & Makoto Ozone
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1995, vibraphonist Gary Burton and pianist Makoto Ozone, both great jazz players noted for their virtuoso technique and innovative style, came together to give a concert of improvised music. They delighted the audience with their fluid, poetic artistry, which was expressed in a performance of the highest order.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Thomas Dunford
programme.sub-title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995 Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007 and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. Paris-born lutenist Thomas Dunford (*1988) discovered the lute at the age of nine. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. He has made various solo and ensemble appearances at Europe's most prestigious festivals.

programme.title: Matchbox Twenty
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Matchbox Twenty performs their hits including "Bright Lights" , "Parade" , "You're So Real", and many more…

programme.title: Jamie Cullum
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Toto
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks. The band formed in LA in the late 70's by a group of friends who were all much in demand session musicians. They went on to epitomize the classic American pop/rock sound of the 80's and 90's with hit albums and singles including Hold The Line, Africa, I'll Be Over You and the multi-Grammy winning worldwide hit Rosanna.

Empieza una divertida misión con un solo objetivo: tener un hijo.

programme.title: La Pareja Del Año
programme.desc: Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones) y Eddie (John Cusack) son AMERICA'S SWEETHEARTS: la pareja favorita del país, dentro y fuera de la pantalla. Pero cuando su romance se convierte en una ruptura, solo el veterano agente de prensa Lee (Billy Crystal) y la ayudante de Gwen, Kiki (Julia Roberts), pueden ayudar a Gwen y Eddie a demostrar algo de amor mientras promocionan su última película juntos.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: Richard Clark es un profesor idealista que trabaja como maestro en una elitista escuela y decide trasladarse al instituto más conflictivo y rebelde de uno de los barrios marginales de la ciudad. Allí, su inocente personalidad y sus sorprendentes técnicas de enseñanza dejarán perplejos a todos los estudiantes y el profesorado. Clark lucha por ser comprendido y no pierde la esperanza de convertir a los alumnos gandules en genios.

programme.title: Ejecutivo Agresivo
programme.desc: El empresario Dave Buznik es normalmente afable y nada polémico. Pero tras un altercado a bordo de un avión, es condenado a participar en un programa de gestión de la ira. Allí descubre que su propio instructor, el Dr. Buddy Rydell, tiene un grave problema de ira, un problema que solo se revelará del todo después de que el doctor se traslade a casa de Dave para darle lecciones prácticas sobre "comportamiento calmado".

programme.title: Novio Por Una Noche
programme.desc: A los diez años, Chuck (Dane Cook) rompió la regla básica del juego de la botella al negarse a besar a una chica gótica demente. Destrozada por su cruel rechazo y decidida a asegurarse que Chuck no encuentre nunca el amor verdadero, la vengativa chica le echa un maleficio al cobarde tramposo que lo persigue hasta su vida adulta. Veinte años después, Chuck es un dentista de éxito que no consigue mantener una relación estable. Un día, mientras asiste a la boda de una ex novia, Chuck se da cuenta de que todas las chicas con las que ha salido encontraron el amor verdadero con el siguiente hombre al que conocieron. Cuando se extiende el rumor de que Chuck es una especie de amuleto de la suerte para las mujeres que quieren casarse, todas las chicas a 150 kilómetros a la redonda empiezan a buscarlo para rollos de una noche Chuck no tarda en percatarse de lo vacío que puede ser el sexo sin amor verdadero. Al conocer a Cam (Jessica Alba), Chuck empieza a sospechar que ha encontrado a la mujer de sus sueños, ¿pero que será de su relación si Chuck y Cam duermen juntos? Ahora, para asegurarse de que Cam no acabe con el siguiente hombre al que conozca, Chuck por fin intentará romper la maldición que lo ha perseguido desde la niñez.

programme.title: Cañones para Córdoba
programme.desc: En 1916, cuando un rebelde mexicano roba cañones del ejército americano, el general Pershing envía a un grupo de inadaptados a recuperar las armas robadas.

programme.title: Venganza sangrienta
programme.desc: Los padres de Tom son asesinados por forajidos mexicanos después de que su líder (Van Cleef) violara a su madre mientras miraba.

programme.title: El hombre de Utah
programme.desc: En un concurso de equitación los malos quieren que John Weston pierda. Cuando éste no acepta, añaden un seguro: una aguja envenenada justo debajo de su montura.

programme.title: La Balada de Davy Crockett
programme.desc: Mucho antes de su heroico final en El Álamo, Davy Crockett se enfrenta a la frontera salvaje para salvar a sus hijos, secuestrados por un cruel terrateniente. En su viaje, luchará contra peligros y desafíos, demostrando su valentía y amor familiar mientras desafía la injusticia en un mundo implacable.

programme.title: ¡Así es mi tierra!
programme.desc: En el México revolucionario, un exitoso ganadero regresa como héroe y se prepara para casarse. Pero su futura esposa ama en secreto a otro hombre, mientras un antiguo rival, amenazado por su popularidad, comienza a tramar un peligroso plan contra él.

programme.title: Una tumba para tres
programme.desc: Cuando tres matones de poca monta que trabajan para un mafioso local cometen un error, son perseguidos por este mientras tratan de enmendar su equivocación.

programme.title: El Dorado y la Ciudad de Oro
programme.desc: Jack y María descubren una pista hacia El Dorado, pero su hallazgo amenaza poderosos intereses. Un oscuro consorcio teme el colapso del mercado del oro y envía a un mercenario para detenerlos, convirtiendo la aventura en una peligrosa persecución.

programme.title: La Hija
programme.desc: Los Amado deciden pasar un fin de semana en la casa de campo de la familia, pero el plan se ve alterado cuando Dominga, la mujer de la limpieza de los Amado, da a luz a un bebé en medio de una reunión familiar.

programme.title: Fast Track: Máxima velocidad
programme.desc: Danny Krueger, joven piloto callejero, gana una beca en Fast Lane Racing Academy. Tras un incidente que lo deja sin compañero, debe unir fuerzas con un antiguo rival para competir por un puesto en un equipo profesional, enfrentando tensión dentro y fuera de la pista.

programme.title: Llamarada solar
programme.desc: Un joven descubre una enorme tormenta solar a punto de destruir la red eléctrica de la Tierra y debe alertar al mundo antes de que un poderoso empresario lo detenga.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: El callejón
programme.desc: En una noche invernal, Rosa se ve obligada a hacer la colada en una lavandería situada en un oscuro y desierto callejón. Allí sufrirá el acoso de un asesino en serie que la someterá al sádico juego del ratón y el gato.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Quién eres
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de María, una joven que busca formar parte de un grupo y que es bastante ingenua. Después de una gran discusión con su amiga Clara, decide pasar el rato hablando con Lucas, un hombre que ha conocido a través de internet y del que sabe más bien poco.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Un largo viaje (2023)
programme.desc: Una vieja autocaravana será el nuevo hogar de Violeta y Samuel con vistas a un complejo comercial del sur de Madrid, donde tratarán de reconciliarse y hacer frente a la vida con tan solo veintidós euros en el bolsillo y “mucha imaginación”.

programme.title: Creatura
programme.desc: Tras mudarse con su pareja a un nuevo hogar, Mila se da cuenta de que su pérdida de deseo se encuentra en sí misma. A partir de ahí, empieza un viaje en el que revisita experiencias de su infancia y adolescencia con la esperanza de reconciliarse con su propio cuerpo.

programme.title: Tombstone Rashomon
programme.desc: The Tombstone story told in the style of the Japanese classic "Rashomon", where we see history from several perspectives including that of Wyatt Earp, Doc Holliday, Kate, Ike Clanton, Colonel Hafford and Johnny Behan.

programme.desc: Detective Ricardo Colletti's personal life is turned upside down when his wife is raped by members of a notorious street gang. When two of the gang members are found dead, Internal Affairs Bureau makes a bold move to catch their suspect.

programme.title: Top Gunner
programme.desc: Los graduados de una remota base de las Fuerzas Aéreas estadounidenses deben proteger un arma biológica de edición genética de los militares rusos, que están desesperados por hacerse con el agente vírico a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Cambio mortal
programme.desc: David Terran, un brillante científico, ha perdido su credibilidad a causa de sus teorías apocalípticas. Las explosiones nucleares en Irán tendrán graves repercusiones y la comunidad científica tendrá que confiar en David.

programme.title: Fast and fierce: death race (esp)
programme.desc: Jack Tyson es un joven que participa en una carrera automovilística ilegal de México a California cuando una mujer desesperada, que huye de su abusivo novio gánster que financia el torneo, se sube a su coche pidiendo su ayuda y tiene una unidad USB incriminatoria que podría enviar a su novio matón, entre otros, a prisión.

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: El mundo del triasico
programme.desc: Los científicos consiguen dar vida a los dinosaurios para extraer sus órganos y salvar a los humanos. Pero cuando las criaturas escapan, los científicos tienen que luchar por sus vidas.

programme.title: Los Cuatro Guerreros
programme.desc: Cuatro valientes caballeros intentarán dar caza a un malvado depredador casi invencible. Su misión es capturar al secuestrador de todos los hombres y niños de una aldea devastada.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Pompeya, año 79 d.C. Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: La promesa del pistolero
programme.desc: Cuando un pistolero obsesionado por el pasado mata accidentalmente a un extraño en un tiroteo, empieza para él un inesperado viaje que lo llevará por el camino de la redención.

programme.title: Perfect weapon (Arma Perfecta)
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, una organización gubernamental y secreta dirigida por EL DIRECTOR controla todos los aspectos de la vida. Todos “los enemigos del estado” son castigados de manera severa y muchos de ellos son ejecutados mediante asesinos de la organización.

programme.title: Skin Trade: Tráfico humano
programme.desc: Cuando su familia es asesinada por un gánster serbio con intereses internacionales, un detective de la policía Nueva York, Nick, viaja al Sudeste Asiático para formar equipo con un detective tailandés para vengarse y destruir una red de tráfico humano.

programme.title: Soldado de Fortuna
programme.desc: Un antiguo miembro de los Boinas Verdes debe llevar a cabo una misión cerca de la frontera de Afganistán.

programme.title: Terms & Conditions
programme.desc: El asesino a sueldo Vet Jones recibe un ultimátum de su antiguo jefe: mata al objetivo o muere su hijo.

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: Un cerebro criminal se enfrenta a un oficial retirado.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: Mujer huye de predicador vengativo en el Oeste.

programme.title: Escape Room (2019)
programme.desc: Una intrigante invitación reúne a seis extraños para participar en un escape room, pero pronto descubrirán que son víctimas de un sádico juego a vida o muerte. Habitación tras habitación, avanzarán por los terroríficos escenarios buscando y resolviendo las pruebas, pero sobre todo, los jugadores deberán aprender a confiar los unos en los otros y desvelar sus secretos más oscuros para sobrevivir.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Del productor Peter Jackson y el director Neill Blomkamp surge un asombrosamente original thriller de ciencia ficción que en el que se envía a un grupo de refugiados alienígenas, varados en la Tierra a un barrio bajo a las afueras de Johannesburgo.

programme.title: El Libro de Eli
programme.desc: Eli (Denzel Washington), un guerrero solitario, camina en una tierra arrasada por la hecatombe una tierra que una vez fue los Estados Unidos. Se dirige hacia el Oeste para llevar a cabo una misión que no acaba de entender del todo pero que sabe que debe cumplir. Protege con su vida la última copia de un libro sagrado que puede ser la llave para salvar la humanidad. Sólo Carnegie (Gary Oldman), un autoproclamado jefe militar que gobierna una ciudad de ladrones y pistoleros, conoce el poder que Eli tiene en sus manos y ha decidido arrebatárselo. Pero nada puede interponerse en el camino de Eli. Nada puede impedirle cumplir con su destino y ayudar a un mundo arruinado.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hollywood
programme.desc: Érase una vez... en Hollywood de Quentin Tarantino, nos traslada a Los Ángeles de 1969, donde todo está cambiando, y donde la estrella de la televisión Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio), y Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt), su doble desde hace muchos años, se abren camino en una industria que ya prácticamente no reconocen. La novena película del célebre escritor y director cuenta con amplio reparto y múltiples tramas argumentales que rinden un tributo a los momentos finales de la época dorada de Hollywood.
